subject: Social Media
title: The Outrage Machine
description: A fast breakdown of The Outrage Machine for builders.

hook.text: Each moral-emotional word in a tweet boosts retweet rate by 20%. Outrage is the top fuel.

buildup.text: Anger spreads faster than any emotion online. Outrage posts get three times more engagement.

discovery.text: Algorithms can't read morality. They see outrage as high engagement and reward it with reach.

twist.text: News outlets learned the lesson. Headlines shifted from informing to provoking. Clicks over clarity.

climax.text: Social media didn't invent anger. It built the most efficient anger distribution system ever.

punchline.text: The algorithm isn't angry. It profits from yours.

quiz.question: By how much does a moral-emotional word boost retweet rate?
